name: Image-Parallel Sheet Buffer Splatting
definition: A splatting algorithm that eliminates popping artifacts by using sheet buffers parallel to the image plane and accumulating contributions from pre-integrated kernel sections within a 'slicing slab' of fixed width, rather than adding entire voxel contributions to a single sheet aligned with volume axes.
summary: Image-Parallel Sheet Buffer Splatting eliminates color popping by maintaining sheet buffers parallel to the image plane and compositing pre-integrated kernel sections along the viewing axis.
